## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are facing. (e.g. *I'm always frustrated when...*)

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision the feature working.

## Alternative Solutions Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Visual Mockups / Concept References
If applicable, add sketches, UI wireframes, or reference screenshots to illustrate your idea.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, performance considerations, or platform-specific notes about the feature request here.
